title: Ledgerly / Sunpeak Dental
transcript:
Ravi: Hi Kate, thanks for jumping on. You mentioned some frustration in your email?
Kate: Yes. Three times this month patients got duplicate invoices. Our front desk spends ages apologising. It happens when we edit an appointment after it's billed.
Ravi: That's not acceptable, I'm sorry. Can you send me two or three invoice numbers where it happened?
Kate: I'll email them after this.
Ravi: Thanks. I'll get engineering on it and update you by Thursday.
Kate: The other thing. Our contract renews in January and, honestly, the owners are looking at Dentally. It's cheaper and they say it handles health fund claims natively.
Ravi: Understood. How are the two new clinics finding it?
Kate: They barely use it. The staff there never got proper training.
Ravi: That's on us. Let me run a training session for both new clinics. Could we do next week?
Kate: Wednesday afternoon works.
Ravi: Great. On health fund claims, that's on our roadmap. I'll check with product on timing and come back to you.
Kate: That would help. If it's coming in the next six months, that matters for the renewal.
Ravi: And before January, can we set up a renewal review with the owners? I'd like to show them usage and what's coming.
Kate: Sure, early December probably.
